title: Common Voice Scripted Speech 26.0 Australian English
citation: Mozilla Data Collective Curators. Common Voice Scripted Speech 26.0 Australian English, dataset cmrt710620013mm071t45y6wb.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Do not rehost or re-share, do not attempt reidentification, maintain reasonable safeguards, and cease use or delete copies if required by account termination and the applicable dataset licence.

population.description: Validated Australian English accented scripted speech subset with 55,922 clips from 804 self identified speakers in the supplied speaker disjoint splits.
limitations: Accent information is self reported context rather than phonetic truth.
Sentence validation does not prove every phone matched one pronunciation.
The subset does not provide Australian lexical pronunciation variants or phone timestamps.

annotation.provenance: Common Voice sentence prompts, listener validation votes and optional self reported metadata; no phone annotation.
limitations: A validated sentence is suitable for robustness testing only.
Self reported demographic fields are optional and cannot create pronunciation truth.

inspected_materials: Downloaded archive SHA256 matched the API checksum.
train.tsv, dev.tsv and test.tsv fields, rows and client identifiers audited privately.
findings: The package contains 52,984 train, 1,540 dev and 1,398 test clips.
The splits contain 754, 16 and 34 speakers respectively.
No client identifier appears in more than one supplied split.

participant_split.source_split_provenance: The package supplies train, dev and test TSV files with zero client identifier overlap.
participant_split.project_strategy: Map source train to development, source dev to threshold tuning and source test to frozen held out evaluation.

lineage.duplicate_detection: Private client and clip identifiers must be checked against every Common Voice derived source before assembly.
